The chessboard secret: doubling. ♟️
One grain on the first square, doubling every square. By the 64th, it is impossible to imagine.
Rule of 72: divide 72 by your yearly return to estimate years to double. 6% → 12 years. 12% → 6 years. 24% → 3 years.
Rule of 72 is an approximation; returns shown are examples only. Not a promise of profit.
Be patient. Follow @spider.trades
⚠️ For educational purposes only. This is not financial advice. Trading involves risk; try it at your own risk.
